Hello Mokusei-sensei!! It's nice to meet you. 

I would like to ask for your assistance in creating a new character, named Noa. He's my original character in a world where Digimon exist as personal assistants. I can somewhat draw myself, but I'm really terrible at creating my own designs and outfits. I also don't have much time to draw these days. 

Noa is an adult in his early 20s who used to be a musical artist, but he quit when an accident took the life of his older brother. Now, his job is just to edit and record music for others, but he rarely sings himself. From afar, he looks aloof and cold, but he's surprisingly quite kind and warm, especially towards people younger than him. He doesn't have any patience for adults, especially if he thinks they're being dumb. He's kind of selfish, though, and only works for himself.

He reluctantly gets along with the digimon that becomes his partner (tentatively named 'Furomon') and ends up growing to be a better person alongside Furomon while solving the mysteries of his world, his family, and even himself.

I have a few collections of outfits I like, and a rough sketch I did when I first tried to create this character, but ultimately I would like to leave the design up to you and what you feel would look best. 
https://imgur.com/a/IfCaZYp (Rough sketch of Noa)

I'd like his hair to be messy and white with some sort of accent color, but the exact details of that can differ even from the rough sketch I did. For clothing, I think I tend to like asymmetrical outfits with slim waistlines but chunky pants and jackets. I really like the outfits you did in these skebs:
https://skeb.jp/@mokusei0516/works/211 & https://skeb.jp/@mokusei0516/works/330

Originally, I wanted him to have goggles or glasses like digimon protagonists always had, but I'm not sure if I really like the idea for him in such a futuristic setting (it's too cliche), so I thought maybe it would be cool if he had a mask of some sort. (maybe he goes out at night to hunt troublesome digimon?) Maybe a simple, carved mask with angular features? Like hollow knight, or sky: children of the light. I have a few images of masks in the pinterest board, but if it's too hard, feel free to omit it!!
https://pin.it/6Y5tOe6Wv (Please note that the pinterest board is not a strict request at all. It's just a collection of outfits and other things I happen to like!)

His digimon partner doesn't have a design yet, but if it helps, it will be based off of a mink/stoat/ferret! My favorite colors are orange and cyan, but I think maybe the majority of his clothing should be monochromatic, with those colors as accents. But like the rest, I'll leave that up to you!

Thank you for considering my request!!

【キャラクター設定について】

今回、OCに新しい世界観を設定しました。設定は、ファンタジー世界の魔物ハンターです~

ポジション： だいたい少年漫画の中盤で登場するような、「頼れる先輩」のような立ち位置です。普段は仲間と魔物を狩っています。楽天家でサバサバしており、少し電波系なところもありますが、いざという時は非常に頼りになる先輩です。

彼女は生物学の研究が好きで、珍しい生物の標本を見ると、つい大金を払ってしまいます。実は重度のショタコンで、それが高じて孤児院の顧問になりました。「愛する少年たちがより良い生活を送れるように」と、命がけで任務をこなして稼いでいます！

【デザインのご依頼】

衣装のイメージ： ファンタジー風の、戦闘に適した、少しかっこいいスタイルでお願いします。もし可能であれば、フード付きの白いマントも合わせていただけますでしょうか。もちろん、それ以外のスタイルでも大歓迎です！先生の想像力で自由にアレンジしてください。

体型は一般的な少女のバランスでお願いします。髪型も先生にお任せします、自由に変えていただいて構いません。先生のデザインなら、どんなものでも嬉しいです！
